programme.desc: A case of mistaken identity lands Slevin into the middle of a war being plotted by two of the city's most rival crime bosses: The Rabbi and The Boss.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: The journey leads from the Norwegian Vesterålen to Chad, the Aeolian Islands and the Polish Giant Mountains. As different as the landscapes and cultures may be, all people are united in their love for their children and their desire to give something to tomorrow's generation.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: What ideas are people on the 15th meridian east developing to shape the future and leave tomorrow's generations a home worth living in? This consequence leads us to four future designers. From the barren Namib Desert to the glacier worlds of Spitsbergen, Sicily and the Croatian Mediterranean.

programme.title: Gronland - In the Glare of Ice
programme.desc: Greenland is the largest island in the world and the landmass closest to the North Pole. 80% of the country is covered by a layer of ice up to 3000 meters thick. Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland.

programme.title: Dust And Stripes
programme.desc: In a never-ending quest for grass and water, the striped herds undertake an annual epic trek across the vast lunar landscape of the Kalahari’s Makgadikgadi Pans. Most of the year, the Makgadikgadi is an inhospitable wasteland of windswept, salt-encrusted pans. For the area’s water-dependent zebra, the Boteti River on the western edge of the pans is a dry-season lifeline. However, it is also a death trap, with lions waiting in ambush and crocodiles lurking in dark riverside caves.

programme.title: Alpine Lakes - Dark Depths and Icy Heights
programme.desc: This is a nature documentary, which leads us into the fascinating world of deep mountain lakes. We conquer ice palaces of unsuspected beauty. In the freezers, in which elves, fairies and mountain trolls once did their mischief, we move, using a special breathing technique and with special cameras in search of nocturnal hunters, whose eyes are equipped with residual light amplifying receptors.

programme.title: Montenegro - From the Black Mountains to the Beach
programme.desc: The Balkan land of Montenegro owes its name to the Black Mountains. But there is so much more: steep cliffs, deep gorges, picturesque lakes, orthodox monasteries, Venetian architecture, sandy beaches and even fjords like those of Norway. There are three climate zones alone in the Adriatic. The inhabitants still try to find their way between the challenges of a post-socialist system, the much-vaunted Balkan remoteness and the opportunities of a still almost completely undiscovered tourist destination in Europe.

programme.title: Wild Bavaria
programme.desc: The moon disappears behind the horizon and the stage is set for a new day in the Alps of Berchtesgaden.

programme.title: Wild Bavaria
programme.sub-title: Wild Bavaria - In The Shadow of the Watzmann.
programme.desc: Mighty and mysterious, King Watzmann sits above Germany's only alpine national park.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, Florida - The Sunshine State
programme.desc: Nowhere is the American way of life as relaxed as on Florida's beaches. The Keys, a chain of islands at the far southern end of the state, reveal a more laid-back side of the USA. But all of Florida amazes -- with secluded beaches, unspoiled nature, and the legacy of the early European settlers.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, The City and the Sea
programme.desc: The journey up the coast continues through Delaware to suburban New Jersey, and onwards into the heart of Manhattan. In Delaware, famous as a corporate tax haven, we visit a winery. In New York City we zip around with a bicycle courier and then head out to Long Island for oysters.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, The Heart of New England
programme.desc: From New York, the journey up the coast leads into the heart of New England. We visit Yale; spend some time in the 19th century mansions at Newport, RI; tour the coastal fishing and vacation towns of Massachusetts, and then meet a modern entrepreneur in Boston and see her rooftop gardens.

programme.title: Wild Baltic
programme.sub-title: Wild Baltic - Life on the Amber Coast
programme.desc: The first episode of this two-part nature documentary presents the natural beauty of the shifting sand dunes of the Curonian Spit, the romantic beaches of the Latvian Baltic Sea and the island worlds of Estonia. Time and again, this deserted and almost untouched nature fascinates. In the winter, ringed seals give birth to their young on the pack ice. In the spring, Konik wild horse stallions fight fierce battles amongst themselves, while colourful European rollers fly through the dune forests. Lynxes wander through the coastal forests and in the orchid meadows turncoats and hoopoes find more than enough food. On the islands around Saaremaa in Estonia, grey seals hunt for fish. They share the archipelago with Europe’s largest tern, the Caspian tern.

programme.title: Wild Baltic
programme.sub-title: Wild Baltic - Enchanted Forests and Moors
programme.desc: The wide, often untouched wilderness of the Baltic hinterland is home to many animals. More than 35 brown bears live in the primeval forests of Alutaguse. In the spring, the Soomaa National Park transforms into a huge lake. Europe's widest waterfall is located in Latvia. In the beginning of May, vimba bream follow the course of the River Venta. The hardly 5-centimetre-long fish have to overcome a 4-metre-long rock barrier in order to reach their spawning grounds.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Halsema Highway, situated on the island Luzon, leads right through the Philippine jungle with its frequent fog and heavy rainfalls. Every trip on this so-called road is an adventure and highly dangerous. We accompany a bus driver and a taxi driver on their challenging trip across the mountains.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Canadian ice roads exist only for a few months in the winter when the ice is thick enough. The only time of the year when goods can be transported up to Northern Manitoba. We accompany the truckers Vlad and Hugh as well as the aboriginal Canadian Scott with his pick-up on their long journey to a village called God’s Lake. A risky trip in icy temperatures, sometimes even below - 60 degrees Celcius. The men are in constant danger of getting stuck and need to forget everything they ever learnt about driving on a highway in order to arrive safely.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: India's state of Rajasthan is known for its ancient palaces, vast landscapes - and wild transport routes. For thousands of years, dromedaries served as the most important means of transport. Today, India's roads are considered fast-paced, chaotic and unpredictable. On a journey through the desert state, we discover its rough roads.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yellowstone National Park is an American national park located in the western United States, largely in the northwest corner of Wyoming and extending into Montana, and Idaho. It was established by the U.S. Congress and signed into law by President Ulysses S. Grant on March 1, 1872. Yellowstone was the first national park in the U.S. and is also widely held to be the first national park in the world. The park is known for its wildlife and its many geothermal features, especially Old Faithful geyser, one of its most popular. While it represents many types of biomes, the subalpine forest is the most abundant. It is part of the South Central Rockies forests ecoregion.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.sub-title: America's National Parks - Great Smoky Mountains
programme.desc: Great Smoky Mountains National Park is an American national park in the southeastern United States, with parts in Tennessee and North Carolina. The park straddles the ridgeline of the Great Smoky Mountains, part of the Blue Ridge Mountains, which are a division of the larger Appalachian Mountain chain. The park contains some of the highest mountains in eastern North America, including Clingmans Dome, Mount Guyot, and Mount Le Conte. The border between the two states runs northeast to southwest through the center of the park. The Appalachian Trail passes through the center of the park on its route from Georgia to Maine. With 12.5 million visitors in 2019, the Great Smoky Mountains National Park is the most visited national park in the United States.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: North America’s National Parks are world famous and their breathtaking landscapes fascinate millions of visitors. This spectacular series will show you what happens beyond the lookouts. Everglades National Park is an American national park that protects the southern twenty percent of the original Everglades in Florida. The park is the largest tropical wilderness in the United States, and the largest wilderness of any kind east of the Mississippi River. An average of one million people visit the park each year. Everglades is the third-largest national park in the contiguous United States after Death Valley and Yellowstone. UNESCO declared the Everglades & Dry Tortugas Biosphere Reserve in 1976, and listed the park as a World Heritage Site in 1979, while the Ramsar Convention included the park on its list of Wetlands of International Importance in 1987. Everglades is one of only three locations in the world to appear on all three lists.

programme.title: Project Antarctica
programme.desc: Why don't you do something sensible? - Tim, Michael and Dennis have heard this sentence more than once since their school days when they professed their dream jobs: Artist, photographer, filmmaker. And they went on to say that some dreams had to remain dreams, that work didn't have to be fun, but above all that it had to pay enough and be safe. A few years later, the three are working on their joint feature film. They put all their eggs in one basket and are determined to invest two years of working time to achieve their goal. Unpaid. It's not just any goal: the three want to travel to Antarctica. They want to find out whether it is possible to reach even the most distant destinations if you only want to. With ten boxes full of equipment, they set off on the 14,000 km journey to Antarctica. And thus on the journey of a lifetime...

programme.title: Darkwoods - Where Nature Survives
programme.desc: Half a century ago the German Duke Carl von Württemberg purchased a 55.000-hectare parcel of land in the Selkirk Mountains in British Columbia, Canada. He baptized his holdings after his native Black Forest, "Darkwoods", and managed the forests in the lonely region sustainably.

programme.title: mareTV: The Caribbean for explorers: St. Vincent and the Grenadines
programme.desc: Much more Caribbean than on the islands of St. Vincent and the Grenadines is hardly possible. Deserted beaches, uninhabited islands, lush vegetation, the 33 islands in total are dreamlike with extremely hospitable inhabitants. Miranda Phillips runs a laundry and water boat on Bequia. Every morning, the 32-year-old navigates from yacht to yacht with her small bright green service vehicle and is already expected by most skippers. Miranda promises radiantly fresh laundry, which she delivers again the same day. And so there is always something going on in her tiny laundrette in the harbour. It turns into a karaoke bar in the evening, because that is Miranda's great passion. Eban Olliver has many jobs at once. He is the lighthouse keeper of Kingstown. And that means a lot of responsibility in St. Vincent's biggest port city. Because Eban doesn't just change the light bulbs, he's a pilot dispatcher, harbour master and guard all in one person. First contact with ships is particularly important. Once he even saved the entire nation from an Ebola virus.

programme.title: mareTV: Martinique
programme.desc: The island of Martinique is a piece of France in the Caribbean, between Florida and South America. And of course, Savoir-vivre applies just as it does on the other side of the Atlantic, between the English Channel and the Mediterranean. Jacky Pascault is the first and only man to cultivate mushrooms in the Caribbean. Everywhere else, they grow on artificially fertilised soil, but Jacky's Champignons Tropicaux flourish on sugar cane fibres. Nicole Vilo tailors hats and dresses out of coconut palms. Of course, the catwalk for the models wearing her first collection is one of the countless dream beaches. The Martiniquais sail on boats they call Yole, which have no keel and are therefore difficult to navigate. The crew members hang over the water in breakneck fashion on long wooden poles. Just the job for Yole-boss Max' "problem kids": they not only learn complicated handling, but also team spirit.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.sub-title: Elephants: Back to the Wild: The Orphanage of Elephants - Nairobi Nationalpark
programme.desc: We follow the rescue of a baby elephant. Once rescued, it will be transported by plane to the breeding station and raised with love and commitment. In order to satisfy the little pachyderm’s urge to move while in the breeding station, there is sometimes an adorable football match between the animals.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.sub-title: Elephants: Back to the Wild: The Return of the Elephants - Tsavo-East-Nationalpark
programme.desc: We accompany the first steps of a two-year-old elephant who is just starting his release program. We also observe the story of two young elephants in their first night in the wilderness on their own. Captivating film footage allows us to truly learn how elephants behave in the wild.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.sub-title: Elephants: Back to the Wild: The Return of the Elephants - Tsavo-East-Nationalpark
programme.desc: We accompany the first steps of a two-year-old elephant who is just starting his release program. We also observe the story of two young elephants in their first night in the wilderness on their own. Captivating film footage allows us to truly learn how elephants behave in the wild.

programme.title: Italy My Love
programme.desc: In ten coastal areas of Italy, we encounter people that have a very special relationship with their region. All of them love their country, their traditions and their work. We met with enthusiasts and hedonists that permitted us to take a glimpse into their everyday lives. Young Italians, who have rediscovered nature and its treasures. Others, that preserve the beauty, archaeologists that apply whole new methods, farmers that only cultivate that which the soil needs. Fishermen, who fish in the same way as it was done a century ago and tough, young men who play and dance the Tarantella. Dolphins, giant sea turtles and pink flamingos, which are researched, nursed back to health or simply observed. Cave explorers, sail makers and coffee specialists are also part of the big picture. Flying drone cameras provide birds-eye views and are an important element of the films. The results are spectacular images from completely different angles which provide us with landscape overviews and detailed insights, the likes of which have never been seen before.

programme.title: Wild Alpine Rivers - Life in the Extreme
programme.desc: What would happen to the mountains without water? They would turn into deserts, devoid of life and vegetation. But there are very few mountains without water on our planet. They take care of this themselves, creating their life’s element and taking water directly from the sky by entrapping the clouds around them. This water then collects on the flanks of the mountains, where it turns from rivulets into rivers, that flow out into the oceans. Mountains and water are symbiotic, a cycle that keeps life on earth going. Mountain streams slowly move along meadows before, only moments later, turning into the spray of waterfalls or small mystic lakes. What kind of life can be found in and around this mysterious cosmos? We will investigate the world of the rare Danube salmon and be there to see the Danube bleak spawn. We will follow giant wels catfish into their hideouts, see great crested grebes on their underwater hunting. We go diving under the ice of frozen mountain streams and lakes, discovering life where none was thought possible.

programme.title: Faroe Islands - A Secret Beauty
programme.desc: The Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic, located in the middle of the Gulf Stream between Scotland and Iceland, are an archipelago of eighteen green volcanic islands where a unique culture has developed over the last thousand years. As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Apes and Aliens
programme.desc: The Congo, mighty and deep like no other river - yet still a retreat and a habitat for several of our world's strangest animals. Our closest relatives live deep inside the dense jungles: three of the four giant ape species have made the Congo basin their home. Rich in extraordinary footage, the second episode of "Myths of the Congo" also presents exciting insights into one of the most mysterious and dangerous regions on earth.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Deep and Dangerous
programme.desc: The river that swallows all rivers - this is what the natives call it. In reality, the Congo, when considering its water masses, is the second largest and the deepest river in the world. At its source in the north of Zambia, it starts out as a mere trickle, but on its journey westwards it grows and grows, becoming ever mightier and with it, the animals, too: the shoebill stork hides in the dense papyrus. Metre-long pythons hunt for their prey in trees and huge hippos fight for power and respect in the water. To survive in the Congo, animals have to adapt to extreme conditions. Here, evolution has spawned unique creatures: fish with lungs, wings and those that go hunting on land. The Congo River feeds the second largest rainforest on earth. Here is the home of the forest elephant. Time and again, they are summoned to this one, magic place: the Dzanga Bay. Countless other forest dwellers join them. What makes this place so special?

programme.title: Wild Switzerland
programme.desc: Gentle, green meadows, rugged rock faces, mysterious lakes, dense forests, tall mountains, low-lying river deltas, quietly meandering mountain streams and smack dab in the middle, a unique fauna - THIS is Switzerland! We trace the elementary power of nature and present animals and plants in landscapes that have hardly ever been touched by mankind. Switzerland is an alpine country, but it is also Europe's surge tank. Rivers such as the Rhine and the Rhone have their sources here. Glaciers, crevasses, icy cold caves and the underwater dome of the Verzasca are the unusual settings we chose for this film. We meet with rare, selected animal species and present their behavioural patterns, such as the Swiss or Arven jay, the lynx and albino catfish. Cold, wind, snow and extreme locations demand adaptation that make us marvel.

programme.title: Europe's far North - Lofoten and the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: North Macedonia: Between Traditional Dances and Mini Navy
programme.desc: Northern Macedonia emerged from being a once constituent republic of the former Yugoslavia. Anyone wishing to discover unknown worlds has every chance of finding them in this young Balkan country, full of imposing mountains, lakes of crystal-clear water, original villages and centuries-old customs. Nevertheless, Northern Macedonia, which borders Serbia in the north and Greece in the south, considered to be one of the poorest countries in Europe.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.sub-title: The Secret World of Herbs - In Provence
programme.desc: Its native fragrant flowers and aromatic herbs have made the Provence a brand known worldwide. The wealth of flora found in this region, between the French Alps and the Mediterranean, is unequalled among the French provinces. Around Sault, near Mont Ventoux, the valleys and high plains are carpeted with bright violet: In the hot climate of the South of France, lavender blooms and exudes its fragrance. Monastic healers have been using its aromatic medicinal oil since the Middle Ages. And today an entire industry is based on the trade with this fragrant flower. Yet the livelihood of Provençal lavender farmers is imperiled. In France’s major lavender-growing region, the “Plateau de Valensole”, our viewers encounter Gérard Blanc, who has been hit particularly hard. The lavender farmer lost sixty percent of his harvest to one tiny insect: the leafhopper. This insect has already destroyed half of the lavender acreage, bumping France from its market position as the world’s top producer of lavender oil. The film visits a resolute farmer who, not about to give up, is testing methods to fend off the voracious insect.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.sub-title: The Secret World of Herbs - In India
programme.desc: In India, herbs play an everyday role hardly equalled anywhere in the world. From the tropical green south to the mountains of the northern Himalayas, herbs lend fragrance to joss sticks and soaps, and flavor to the cuisine. And, above all, herbs heal. Six thousand varieties of plants are used in India, and most are harvested in the wild – where they are becoming depleted. The ever rising need for herbal medicine for the subcontinent’s 1.3 billion inhabitants comes on top of the demand of its growing middle class for herbal-based cosmetics. As a result, certain herbs have become scarce, while others have already vanished entirely. Most of the herbs in India are harvested in the wild. The progress of first cultivation attempts is slow. In India, the rural population, especially, needs affordable, well-tolerated medicine – medicine based on herbs. In Kerala, the film shows a family operation that hand-produces botanical medicine for the local market. High up in the Himalayas, we observe a village healer at work. The science of Ayurvedic medicine is five thousand years old. Today, interest in the ancient healing art is surging, not only in India. In Delhi’s Old Town, the film visits a wholesaler who supplies the booming global herb market, and we take a look inside the laboratories of the largest manufacturer of Ayurvedic medicines in the world. In Kerala, we meet a doctor employed at a small Ayurveda clinic, and in Nordern India, we join a student of Tibetan medicine on a hike up into the mountains, where she prepares for an exam in herbology.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.sub-title: The Secret World of Herbs - In Latin America
programme.desc: Healing effects, fragrance, and intense flavor – the benefits of herbs were discovered by the indigenous peoples of South America long before Spanish conquistadores subdued the continent. Even today, in the remote regions of South America, life without herbs is unthinkable. For many inhabitants, they provide the sole medicine. For more than two thousand years, this wisdom of the healing powers of nature has been passed down from generation to generation. In Bolivia, the film accompanies ethnobiologist Rainer Bussmann on one of his expeditions documenting which herbs the locals use against which illnesses. The German scientist has spent the last 15 years in the region, focussed on preserving this invaluable knowledge.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: As contrasting as the landscapes of the 15th meridian east, so different are its animal inhabitants. What are the living conditions like in the heat of the Namibian Damaraland, in Lusatia or on the coast of Norway? Which challenges do elephants, whales or kingfishers have to master together with their companions from north to south?

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: Almost 11000 kilometres lie between the northernmost and southernmost point of the 15th meridian east. Here you will find extreme landscapes such as the shimmering heat of Africa or the eternal cold of northern Scandinavia. Five people from Spitsbergen, Namibia, Slovenia, Germany and Poland dedicate their lives to environmental protection.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: This episode focuses on people from five countries who share a common passion: The production of their own food and food. What culinary treasures are hidden in the different regions, from Spitsbergen to Sweden, Austria, Poland and Chad?

programme.title: Rewilding: Back to Nature
programme.desc: Worldwide, there are various projects and approaches to give nature more space again. The aim is to create larger wilderness areas that develop with hardly any influence of humans - by reintroducing so-called key animal species and creating a network of wilderness corridors across entire continents. Rewilding promises to be a cost-effective form of conservation in which we can boost biodiversity and protect the climate.

programme.title: Poppy's Promise - Secret Life in a Cornfield
programme.desc: The cornfield - just an area for producing food… or a land full of secrets? This doc portrays a little recognized habitat right next door. The spectacular visuals filmed with state of the art equipment introduce the surprisingly large diversity of field inhabitants. We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about. In the western industrial nations cornfields and woods take up the greatest proportion of rural land. But how much natural life dwells in a cornfield? Why are some cornfield inhabitants harmful and others useful and what do the colourful flowers at the edge of the field promise us? We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The racing cyclists of Burundi have a dangerous job. But it’s a vital one for Burundi’s economy. Bicycles are the main means of transportation in one of the smallest countries in Africa. Bananas, the staple food in Burundi, are transported from the markets to a banana beer brewing factory. We accompany Tharcien, a bike courier, on his exhausting cross country trip on the Burundi Highway.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.sub-title: The Road To Death In The Andes
programme.desc: The Carretera de la muerte - the road to death- is one of the most dangerous roads in the world. Year after year many people die here. We accompany trucker Omar and his co-driver Jaime on their trip across the Andes, encountering cyclists, mountain bikers and coca-farmers on the way.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Sichuan Tibet Highway is the road of longing for many. It leads through fascinating landscapes and remote areas up to the Himalayan Mountains. We accompany truck driver Ren Taiping on his trip to the Tibetan capital city of Lhasa, encountering pilgrims, mountain bikers and nomads on this dangerous journey.

programme.title: Caribbean sisters: The Lesser Antilles St. Kitts & Nevis
programme.desc: In the centre of the Caribbean, volcanoes rise steeply from the sea, thus shaping the sister islands of St. Kitts & Nevis. Their slopes, covered in lush rainforests, snow-white, sandy beaches and the surrounding tur-quoise tinted waters provide the ultimate setting for this record-breaking, albeit tiny island paradise: Both islets are the smallest of the Caribbean dwarf states and also rank among the world’s ten smallest states. A hot pepper sauce, made of a creative mixture of ginger, garlic, thyme and extraordinarily hot chillies that thrive in the hot and humid climate of Nevis, is simmering on the stove of Violet and Llewellyn’s house. Lemmy Pemberton digs up abandoned turtle nests with his bare hands, as he wants to be certain that all of the babies have indeed managed to make it. Members of the Turtle Group catch sea turtles in order to take their measurements and fit them with transmitters. Taxi bus-es are not only the main means of transport on St. Kitts & Nevis, they are also an artistic expression of each driver’s personality. Colourfully embellished, each taxi represents island art on wheels.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Olympic National Park is an American national park located in the State of Washington, on the Olympic Peninsula. The park has four regions: the Pacific coastline, alpine areas, the west side temperate rainforest and the forests of the drier east side. Within the park there are three distinct ecosystems which are subalpine forest and wildflower meadow, temperate forest, and the rugged Pacific coast. President Theodore Roosevelt originally designated Mount Olympus National Monument on 2 March 1909. The monument was redesignated as a national park by Congress and President Franklin Roosevelt on June 29, 1938. In 1976, Olympic National Park was designated by UNESCO as an International Biosphere Reserve, and in 1981 as a World Heritage Site. In 1988, Congress designated 95 percent of the park as the Olympic Wilderness.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yosemite National Park is a place of superlatives: with towering cliffs and giant sequoias, home to coyotes, black bears and the most elusive of all: the bobcat. Watch this documentary with ist spectacular shots, aerial views and time-lapse shots and learn some new facts about the biodiversity in one of North Americas most spectacular National Parks.

programme.title: Wild Prairie Man
programme.desc: Located in the Northern Great Plains of Canada, Grasslands National Park has been a 20 year odyssey for wildlife photographer James R. Page. For James, critters are more interesting than people and he shares some of his iconic images and experiences from this endangered ecosystem. We showcase the parks wilderness that is dominated by prairie light and dark sky, the wildlife, prairie dogs, mesmerizing landscapes, and bisons. We immerse ourselves in the wild habitat of Grasslands National Park for over a year capturing some never before scenes in the Wild Prairie. James R. Page's connection to the land and the wildlife provides an unforgettable journey into the heart of this endangered ecosystem, while Park experts help us understand its complexity.

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: Wild Slovakia
programme.desc: Brown bears, wolves, lynx, eagles… where within the European Union are these carnivores still regular inhabitants? Where can you find mountainous regions that yet wait to be discovered by mass tourism?

programme.title: mareTV: Peru - Coast of the Incas
programme.desc: Dramatically, the coast plunges into the sea, the so-called Costa of Peru is a gigantic desert on the Pacific Ocean, 2,400 kilometers long. Rugged, bizarre, like from another star. Ancient cultures settled here, the Moche and the Chimú. Later the proud Inca, the self-proclaimed royal people of the Andes, ruled. In the small town of Huanchaco in northern Peru, the fishermen build a new boat every month: from reed. The small ships are called Caballito de Totora (reed horses), because the shape is reminiscent of a horse and the fishermen ride in it kneeling in the waves. About 2,000 years ago, the moche used it to go out to sea. Carlos Segura Azola is a descendant of the moche. He is currently building a "reed horse" again. But actually something completely different occupies him. Carlos has been afraid of the sea ever since his father drowned at work. The fisherman consults a Brucha, a witch. She tries to drive him out of panic at the Pacific with mysterious ceremonies. At some point Carlos' reed boat is finished and he has to get out to his nets again. In the south, in the port city of Pisco, there are hardly any private cars. Mototaxis on three wheels are the means of transport here. Every moto looks different, because the young drivers compete with each other. They constantly pimp out their tricycles with spoilers, mirrors and all kinds of decorations. Because if you stand out in the traffic jam, you get the most passengers. But nowhere else in Peru is road traffic as dense and chaotic as in the capital Lima. That's why Juan Ortiz goes daily with his Delta glider over the coastal road into the air. He is the flying reporter and reports live for the traffic news. And he is not alone with his aircraft. Dozens of paragliders float along the cliffs of Lima at any time of the day. The Pacific provides a constant upwind on the up to 160 meter high cliffs. Somewhere in the labyrinth of the metropolis of millions hundreds of believers trot to the beat of the music of a Jesus statue on the cross. A procession for the "Lord of Miracles", the brass band intones church songs. The music student Bruno Alvarado drags and plays the largest instrument, a sousaphone. Every day there are dozens of processions in Lima. Practical for Bruno, he finances his studies with the musical accompaniment. Away from the hustle and bustle of the big city, in the Paracas National Park, it is deserted. Luis Zapato runs a kiosk on a lonely beach amidst huge sand dunes. The kiosk has meanwhile developed into a gourmet temple, even the capital city dwellers flock here. Especially because of the scallops that Luis is the only licence holder to collect far and wide from the seabed. Inti Mar he called his beach snack, Inti is the sun god, Mar the sea. At Luis you literally eat like a sun god at the sea. This is only possible here, on the Inca coast.

programme.title: Avatar: Legenden om Aang: Biblioteket

programme.title: Avatar: Legenden om Aang: Ørkenen

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1001

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1002

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1004

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1006

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: From thousands of hopefuls, just two remain to battle it out on the catwalk. Who will Elle Macpherson crown as Britain & Ireland's Next Top Model?

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 1
programme.desc: The show returns for an eighth series with 20 contestants all competing to impress judges Elle Macpherson, Tyson Beckford, Whitney Port and Julien Macdonald to win a contract with Models 1.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 2
programme.desc: The remaining 17 contestants meet with the judges for one-on-one interviews and are scheduled to have a photo shoot with camels in the desert, but it gets canceled due to a sandstorm.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 3
programme.desc: The 13 contestants move into the model house and have a housewarming party, where they are visited by Cycle 7 winner Jade Thompson.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 4
programme.desc: The remaining 12 contestants receive makeovers at the Daniel Galvin salon and get their teeth whitened before being treated to a day out at a skating disco.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 5
programme.desc: The contestants go to the Hurlingham Academy and meet image consultant Vernon Francois for a challenge in which they decorate t-shirts and talk about their insecurities in a motivational speech for the school's students.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 6
programme.desc: The contestants shoot a mock commercial for Alcatel, where they pretend to talk to their lover over the phone with a script written in French.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 7
programme.desc: The contestants meet TV presenter Laura Whitmore for a posing challenge in Carnaby Street under the pouring rain while passersby vote on their favorite contestants.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 8
programme.desc: The remaining contestants take on a catwalk challenge for TRESemmé, walking on a plexiglass runway covered in water. Lisa is chosen as the best performer, winning a year’s worth of TRESemmé products and hair services at the Daniel Galvin salon.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 9
programme.desc: The contestants meet journalist Gordon Smart and participate in a press challenge where they write a 60-second skit regarding their opinions of the other contestants, which they later present in front of the camera.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 10
programme.desc: Letitia, Lisa, and Roxanne receive a second set of makeovers. The contestants meet with Elle at Hyde Park, where they learn that the remaining five contestants will be traveling to Canada for the remainder of the competition.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 10
programme.desc: Letitia, Lisa, and Roxanne receive a second set of makeovers. The contestants meet with Elle at Hyde Park, where they learn that the remaining five contestants will be traveling to Canada for the remainder of the competition.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 11
programme.desc: The remaining five contestants fly to Toronto, where they take on the CN Tower's EdgeWalk before moving into their home at the SoHo Metropolitan Hotel.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 11
programme.desc: The remaining five contestants fly to Toronto, where they take on the CN Tower's EdgeWalk before moving into their home at the SoHo Metropolitan Hotel.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 12
programme.desc: Star of The Hills and America's Next Top Model judge Kelly Cutrone gives the contenders a grilling in Toronto ahead of next week's final.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 12
programme.desc: Star of The Hills and America's Next Top Model judge Kelly Cutrone gives the contenders a grilling in Toronto ahead of next week's final.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 13
programme.desc: Elle Macpherson and the judges join the three finalists on a Toronto beach for a tribal-themed shoot. The remaining two then take part in a fashion show where one of the girls is crowned the winner.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 13
programme.desc: Elle Macpherson and the judges join the three finalists on a Toronto beach for a tribal-themed shoot. The remaining two then take part in a fashion show where one of the girls is crowned the winner.

programme.title: Gumballs Fantastiske Verden: Dietten
programme.desc: Gumball og Darwin oppdager at Fars diett ikke funket fordi han faktisk var på ti dietter, og han spiste ett måltid for hvert av dem.

programme.title: Gumballs vidunderlig ville verden: Burgeren
programme.desc: Gumball og Darwin ønsker å finne et middagsalternativ til familien fordi de er hekta på Joyful Burger, men et selskap har monopolisert matindustrien.

programme.title: Eventyrtid: Sideoppdrag: Arm-bros
programme.desc: Finn blir med i en bueskytterkonkurranse, mens Jake gjør sitt beste for å veie opp for Finns manglende talent.

programme.title: Eventyrtid: Sideoppdrag: Billefin
programme.desc: Finn blir dratt inn i en duell mellom to fisefine biller, og må mestre selskapslivets sus og dus før den store dagen.

programme.title: Eventyrtid: Sideoppdrag: Forbanne-ord
programme.desc: Finn oppdager at Jake har begravd demonforbannelser i hagen. Nå må Finn overtale vennen sin til å konfrontere demonene sine, bokstavelig talt.

programme.title: Eventyrtid: Sideoppdrag: Redningsprinsessen
programme.desc: Finn og Jake må stoppe Iskongen mens han forsøker å kurtisere en uinteressert prinsesse som reddet han.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Full overhaling
programme.desc: Etter å ha vunnet over Broder Blod, belønner Titans seg med en tur til neglesalongen.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Fiskesuppe
programme.desc: Titans er i Boston, og med hjelp fra Deadman leter de etter en legendarisk skål med fiskesuppe.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Når maskene faller – Historien om Teen Titans
programme.desc: En titt bak kulissene på historien til Teen Titans Go!

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Aktiver
programme.desc: Wonder Twins lærer Titans om å spare på vannet.

programme.title: Regular Show: De glemte videoene: Kafeteriakrigen
programme.desc: En ny café skaper konkurranse i byen.

programme.title: Regular Show: De glemte videoene: Boba baluba
programme.desc: Mordecai og Rigby må selge et lass med boblete.

programme.title: Gumballs Fantastiske Verden: Brødrene
programme.desc: Darwin blir sjalu på Gumball og Pennys forrhold.

programme.title: Gumballs Fantastiske Verden: Mannen
programme.desc: Det er Granny Jojos bursdag, og hun har tatt med seg en uventede gjest til middag.

programme.title: Gumballs Fantastiske Verden: Pizzaen
programme.desc: Møt familien Watterson, Mamma, Pappa, Anais, Darwing og selvfølgelig Gumball! Han er en tolv år gammel katt med talent for uhell.

programme.title: Kanicula: Sjokoladevampyrkaninen
programme.desc: Da Kanicula smaker på kakaobønner forvandles han til sjokolade, og blir jaktet på av hvert eneste søtsugne barn i New Orleans. Kanicula

programme.title: Kanicula: Legenden om medaljongen
programme.desc: Kanicula og gjengen finner en medaljong som kan vise dem fremtiden. I dens projeksjoner, ser de noen monstre som er på jakt etter en eldre Mina.

programme.title: Kanicula: Prismefengselet
programme.desc: Kanicula, Christer og Harald befinner seg plutselig i et høysikkerhetsfengsel etter å ha arrangert en vampyr-dansefest!

programme.title: Gumballs Fantastiske Verden: Skylden
programme.desc: Foreldreorganisasjonen på Elmore Ungdomskole forbyr dataspill, så barna prøver å bevise at spill ikke har en dårlig innvirkning.

programme.title: Gumballs Fantastiske Verden: Katastrofen
programme.desc: Rob får endelig kreftene til å ødelegge Gumballs verden.

programme.title: Gumballs Fantastiske Verden: Reprisen
programme.desc: Da vi sist så Gumball, trykket han på tilbakespolingsknappen på Robs universalfjernkontroll. Han er nå tilbake på starten av den katastrofale dagen.

programme.title: Gumballs vidunderlig ville verden: Cheerleaderen
programme.desc: Gumball vil få Richard med på cheerleaderlaget for å få slutt på familiens generasjonstraumer.

programme.title: Looney Tunes Cartoons: Pippip med dagen // Daffy spåmann : Ny kjærlighet // Sprett forover, fall flatt
programme.desc: Sylvester krasjer Pips bursdagsfest. Daffy ser fremtiden. Per Ulv får en spretten gange.

programme.title: Looney Tunes Cartoons: Lur katta // Daffy Trafikkpoliti stopp - båtførerbeviset // Bowling kompisene
programme.desc: Hebbe og Bertie risikerer alt for å bryte seg inn i en ostebutikk. Daffys kjøretur blir forstyrret. Pelle lærer nevøen sin å bowle.

programme.title: Looney Tunes Cartoons: Steinalder-problemer // Troféjegeren
programme.desc: Hule-Daffy og forhistorisk Pelle har et steinaldereventyr. Når Elmer går på jakt, ender han opp med å fange et trofé!

programme.title: Looney Tunes Cartoons: Unnskyld hagen // Slipp katta ut - flatt på døren // ‘Downward’- and
programme.desc: Petunia vil ha hage, men alt hun dyrker blir trøbbel! Sylvester slipper katta ut. Yoga er avslappende, med mindre Daffy er din instruktør.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Super-Robin
programme.desc: Robin er misunnelig på de andres krefter og vil ha sine egne.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Tårnets makt
programme.desc: Cyborg kortslutter når han blir våt, så de andre demonterer ham sånn at han skal tørke.

programme.title: Eventyrtid: Sideoppdrag: Kjærlighetens biller
programme.desc: BMO leker Kirsten Giftekniv med to biller, men Finn og Jake ødelegger med sine egne idéer om hva romantikk er.

programme.title: Eventyrtid: Sideoppdrag: Den reisende grotten
programme.desc: Finn tar med Jake til en grotte fra barndommen, men det viser seg å være en skuffelse, så Jake vil gjøre det like spennende som Finn husket det.

programme.title: Gumballs Fantastiske Verden: Sjefen
programme.desc: Guttene hjelper Rocky med å få en kontorjobb slik at faren hans skulle bli stolt av ham.

programme.title: Gumballs Fantastiske Verden: Trikset
programme.desc: Clayton er en lystløgner, men Gumball oppdager han ikke lyver om sin fantastiske kampsport-trekk.

programme.title: Gumballs Fantastiske Verden: Loven
programme.desc: Møt familien Watterson, Mamma, Pappa, Anais, Darwing og selvfølgelig Gumball! Han er en tolv år gammel katt med talent for uhell.

programme.title: Gumballs Fantastiske Verden: Allergi
programme.desc: Gumball må finne en kur for Darwins allergi før han nyser Elmore ut av kartet.

programme.title: Gumballs vidunderlig ville verden: Manusendringen
programme.desc: Guttene er i ferd med å oppdage sannheten om Elmore, men deres gamle erkefiende bestemmer seg for å omskrive historien.

programme.title: Kanicula: Ridderuglen
programme.desc: Christer innser at Kanincula ikke er nok til å beskytte Orlock mot overnaturlige krefter, hvorpå Kanincula introduserer vennene sine for Ridderuglen.

programme.title: Kanicula: Et farlig pip
programme.desc: Da en ond vikingkrigers ånd vekkes til live og antar formen til en pipete hundeleke, ønsker den hevn over kaninen som fanget den i første omgang!

programme.title: Kanicula: Kaninculas sønn
programme.desc: Christer får det for seg at en aubergine vil få Kanincula til å legge et monsteregg, hvorpå kaninen beslutter å spille Christer et puss!

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Teen Titans drar på verksted, del 1
programme.desc: Mens de er i London for å stoppe Mad Mod, blir Titans’ våpen mot kriminalitet ødelagt, og de drar til et verksted for å få hjelp.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Teen Titans drar på verksted, del 2
programme.desc: Gjengen på verkstedet blir presset til det ytterste for å reparere Titans’ utstyr så de kan stoppe Mad Mods' plan om verdensherredømme.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Philly
programme.desc: Titans er på besøk i Philadelphia og slår seg sammen med Bacon-brødrene for å stoppe William Penns angrep på byen.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Velg din egen vei
programme.desc: Raven, Cyborg og Robin forsvinner inn i en bok og er avhengige av at Beast Boy og Starfire tar de rette avgjørelsene for å komme seg ut.

programme.title: Eventyrtid: Sideoppdrag: Dukkeprinsesse
programme.desc: Iskongen forelsker seg i en prinsesse, men han vet ikke at det bare er en dukke Finn og Jake har laget for å hindre han i å kidnappe prinsesser.

programme.title: Eventyrtid: Sideoppdrag: Tussedronningens sønn
programme.desc: Finn og Jake må hjelpe Iskongen med å sitte barnevakt for den sprø sønnen til en fremmed dronning Iskongen hevder han er sammen med.

programme.title: Gumballs Fantastiske Verden: Spinoff-serien
programme.desc: Gumballs nemesis Rob gir oss en miks av reality, action og komedieserier med andre karakterer enn Gumball for å bli kvitt ham. Men er de bedre?

programme.title: Gumballs Fantastiske Verden: Forvandlingen
programme.desc: Pennys familie liker ikke at hun gikk ut av skallet sitt... bokstavelig talt. Og Penny vil at familien skal ut av skallene sine... bokstavelig talt.

programme.title: Gumballs Fantastiske Verden: Forståelsen
programme.desc: Gumball og Darwin havner i trøbbel når de gjør alt den nye gutten på skolen foreslår. Peter Pepperoni har hatt skole hjemme og snakker på en rar måte.

programme.title: Gumballs Fantastiske Verden: Annonsen
programme.desc: For å få endene til å møtes tvinges Watterson til å leie ut huset sitt. Men uten en annen plass å bo bestemmer de seg for å skjule seg i huset.

programme.title: Gumballs vidunderlig ville verden: Burgeren
programme.desc: Gumball og Darwin ønsker å finne et middagsalternativ til familien fordi de er hekta på Joyful Burger, men et selskap har monopolisert matindustrien.

programme.title: Regular Show: Eggscellent
programme.desc: Rigby blir syk når han deltar i en lokal konkurranse, men Mordecai trår til og prøver å spise en enorm omelett for å vinne en hatt til vennen sin.

programme.title: Regular Show: Magemodell
programme.desc: Muscle Man ønsker å bli satt pris på i parken, så han truer med å dra for å bli en magemodell.

programme.title: Regular Show: De glemte videoene: Rydd stua
programme.desc: Et hemmelig oppdrag må utføres før stua kan ryddes.

programme.title: Regular Show: De glemte videoene: Kunstnersperre
programme.desc: Mordecai friker ut av noen han pleide å sitte barnevakt for.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Fine herrer og herregårder
programme.desc: Robin deltar på Wayne Manor-ballet i håp om å bli utpekt til arving, men kommer resten av Titans til å ødelegge?

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Et trans-oseansk magisk cruise
programme.desc: Det er moro på storhavet når Titans er på et cruise fylt av farlige oppdrag, raske biler og angrep fra verdensrommet!

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Batmans bursdagsgave
programme.desc: Titans blir med Robin når han skal levere en bursdagsgave til Batman, men de havner på avveie flere ganger.

programme.title: Eventyrtid: Sideoppdrag: Forbanne-ord
programme.desc: Finn oppdager at Jake har begravd demonforbannelser i hagen. Nå må Finn overtale vennen sin til å konfrontere demonene sine, bokstavelig talt.

programme.title: Eventyrtid: Sideoppdrag: Redningsprinsessen
programme.desc: Finn og Jake må stoppe Iskongen mens han forsøker å kurtisere en uinteressert prinsesse som reddet han.

programme.title: Eventyrtid: Grensen
programme.desc: Finn og Jake må risikere alt for å få oppfyllt sine drømmer i kjernen av en magisk ønske-labyrint.

programme.title: Eventyrtid: Varmesøkende
programme.desc: Marceline lurer Finn og Jake til å tro at de er vampyrer, men kanskje går denne spøken litt for langt.

programme.title: Gumballs Fantastiske Verden: Synet
programme.desc: Når Gumball og Darwin ved et uhell finner et dystert og mørkt manifest på Alans minnepenn, bestemmer de seg for å sette en stopper for planen hans.

programme.title: Gumballs Fantastiske Verden: Valgene
programme.desc: Nicole husker dagen hun møtte Richard for første gang og de ulike valgene hun kunne gjort.

programme.title: Tapper, den pysete hunden: Det magiske treet/Robot Randy
programme.desc: Tapper beskytter Matilda Knots magiske ønsketre fra å bli hugget ned. / En krigsrobot forvandler gjengen til sine slaver.

programme.title: Tapper, den pysete hunden: Shirleys forbannelse/Tapper i den store stygge byen
programme.desc: Tapper finner en boks nedgravd i hagen. / Tapper tvinges til å levere en pakke fra en ond kakkerlakk.

programme.title: Gumballs vidunderlig ville verden: Spådommen
programme.desc: Gumball og Penny må holde sammen gjennom hele skoledagen for å bevise at de er ment for hverandre, til tross for en spådom fra Herr Liten.

programme.title: Charterfeber
programme.desc: Roger er tilbake på Gran Canaria og viser en ny side som lidenskapelig cowboyfan. Harstadfamilien får en kaotisk start på ferien, og vi møter Wiggo fra Fredrikstad, som ikke har vært utenlands siden 1987.

programme.title: Charterfeber
programme.desc: Odelsguttene oppsøker en aloe vera-plantasje på jakt etter inspirasjon, men sitter igjen med flere spørsmål enn svar. Wiggo og Larsern utforsker øyas fugleliv, mens Harstadfamilien lar seg rive med på et heftig booze cruise.

programme.title: Charterfeber
programme.desc: Morten prøver desperat å skaffe en date til søsteren Hilde – med varierende hell. Roger er på jakt etter en ny høyttaler som kan løfte stemningen til nye høyder. Samtidig feirer pensjonistene Elsas bursdag med et fargesprakende dragshow.

programme.title: Charterfeber
programme.desc: Wiggo og Larsern kaster både snøre og konkurranseinstinkt ut i havgapet i det fiskelykken skal settes på prøve. Odelsguttene prøver seg som papaya-bønder, mens Taxigjengen går på en aldri så liten smell med en slu lokal sjåfør.

programme.title: Charterfeber
programme.desc: Roger vil sende postkort hjem til Norge, men i syden er selv de enkleste planer ikke alltid helt rett frem. Familien Østvik nekter å ta ferie fra treningen, mens damene fra Buskerud gjør sin entré på øya.

programme.title: Charterfeber
programme.desc: Odelsguttene bruker feriedagen på en noe utradisjonell severdighet da de besøker en sementfabrikk på Gran Canaria. Roger legger ut på guidet tur i Las Palmas, men språkbarrierer gjør opplevelsen mer forvirrende enn opplysende.

programme.title: Charterfeber
programme.desc: Wiggo og Larsern legger ut på jakt etter en sjelden fugl, men Wiggos kallerop skremmer bort alt som har fjær. Fred Åge pimper scooteren sin, og får jackpot på Holiday World. Etter en lang reise fra Nord-Norge ankommer endelig familien Valan.

programme.title: Charterfeber
programme.desc: Pensjonistene avslutter ferien med å jakte de beste kuppene. Familien fra Harstad får erfare at det ikke alltid er like enkelt å lade elbil på Gran Canaria. Hilde og Morten bytter ut strandliv og paraplydrinker med bobileventyr.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Pride Party
programme.desc: Gjengen feirer Pride som bare geordier kan med alle husfesters mor - og en overraskelsesgjest! Sophie ender i tårer og Chloe er ikke imponert over Alex. Sam kommer tilbake og Abbie og den nye fyren Adam nærmer seg hverandre.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Gotta Have Faith
programme.desc: Geordie-gjengen er tilbake på hjemmebane og klare for å skape mer leven enn noen gang. Denne gangen får de besøk av noen gamle kjenninger, noen nye ansikter, og venner og familie mens de gjør seg klare til å male byen rød igjen.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Geordie Dinner Party
programme.desc: Chloe og Sam viser fram sitt nye hjem når de inviterer gjengen på innvielsesfest. Nathan vakler når han skjønner at han må jobbe på Scotts første jobb. Faith oppdager snart at ikke alt bare er en stor fest når hun støter sammen med Chloe.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Girls Trip
programme.desc: Sophie bestemmer at jentene trenger en sammensveisings-ferie i Blackpool, mens guttas forhold aldri har vært så ille. Faith snakker ut med Chloe, men det er ikke sikkert at hun husker særlig mye neste morgen!

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Sophie And Sam Fall Out
programme.desc: Gjengen kunne ikke hatt det bedre etter turen til Blackpool, men det endrer seg når de er tilbake i by'n. Faith blir uvenner med Nathan og spenninger mellom Sam og Chloe renner over og gjør at de pakker kofferten.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: It's Snowing In Newcastle
programme.desc: Abbie og Adam sliter med vennskapet og Nathan føler seg sviktet av Chloe som setter kjæresten Sam, først. Faith føler seg omsider som én av gjengen, og Scott tar med gjengen på dykking i tank.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Benidorm Bound
programme.desc: Geordiene prøver seg på burlesk dans og inviterer venner på en spillkveld. Anna sender dem til Benidorm. Gjengen gjør furore på The strip, men Sophie slår Sam etter at han enda en gang kaller henne sjalu.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Nana Joins The Gang
programme.desc: Sophie ber om unnskyldning for å ha slått Sam og geordiene har en herlig dag i vannparken. Gjengen drar på klubb med Abbies bestemor, og det er akkurat det som trengs for å sveise familien sammen igjen.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: A Double Return
programme.desc: Sophie mister munn og mæle når Alex fra Australia kommer på overraskelsesbesøk. Det er god stemning i huset når Holly kommer tilbake og tar med gjengen til Newcastle Pride for fest, drikking og dansing!

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Holly Gets A Shock
programme.desc: Chloe tar med Sam på en hemmelig date som gjør at det går kaldt nedover ryggen hans. Alex må fornedre seg for Sophie, og Scotty T gjør livet pinlig for Holly da han tar med hennes ekskjæreste Kyle på jobb.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Geordie Fest
programme.desc: Familien feirer Abbies 21-årsdag med den ultimate hjemmefesten, og selvsagt er Abbies bestemor invitert! Familien tar et følsomt farvel når tiden deres opphører.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: All Change In The House

programme.desc: Etter at Chrissy og Charlie Billis filmet sitt TV-program i Vermont, havnet de i en bilulykke. Bare én overlevde. Kan opptakene avsløre noe?

programme.title: American Monster: Push Record
programme.desc: Det idylliske livet til Harold og Toni Henthorn ødelegges av en dødelig ulykke på en fjelltur. Men en hjemmevideo skjuler en morderisk gjerningsmann.

programme.title: Still A Mystery: Suffer The Children
programme.desc: En femåring forsvinner, og en mor i Colorado dør etter å ha blitt med en fremmed hjem.

programme.title: Still A Mystery: Secrets In The DNA
programme.desc: En lastebilsjåfør finner en mor etterlatt død på en motorvei i Missouri, og et trippeldrap herjer en familie.

programme.title: High Speed Chase: We Might Die Today
programme.desc: I Ohio fører en stjålet varebil til en actionfylt biljakt, men når sjåføren ringer nødtelefonen, oppdager politiet at han ikke er alene i bilen.

programme.title: High Speed Chase: Maximum Overdrive
programme.desc: En hensynsløs sjåfør av en 18-hjuler skaper kaos i Texas, og en mann flykter etter å ha knivstukket en lege i Florida.

programme.title: Forsvunnet: Forsvunnet den 4. juli
programme.desc: Etter en krangel med kjæresten forlater Roxanne Paltauf motellet og kommer aldri tilbake. Hva var årsaken til forsvinningen?

programme.title: Forsvunnet: Hemmelig stevnemøte
programme.desc: Patti Adkins slutter på jobb ved midnatt og forsvinner. Informasjon om et mystisk forhold og et hemmelig møte maler et problemfylt bilde.

programme.title: I'd Kill for You: Killer Alien
programme.desc: Linda treffer sin drømmemann, dr. Diazien Hossencofft. Men han er midt i en bitter skilsmisse - hvor langt vil ekskona gå for å få hevn?

programme.title: I'd Kill for You: Mother of All Murders
programme.desc: Familien Pedroza ser ut til å leve det perfekte liv i varme Florida. Under fasaden er familien i kaos - og det fører raskt til en tragedie.

programme.title: Mean Girl Murders: Tough Cookies
programme.desc: På kjeksfabrikken i Perry i New York oppstår det raskt både vennskap og rivalisering. Det som starter som slarv mellom kolleger, blir snart mye verre.

programme.title: Mean Girl Murders: Wicked Witches
programme.desc: Tre kvinner blir venner på grunn av sin felles forkjærlighet for heksekunst. Men når en av dem tror hun har blitt forhekset, tar hun en dødelig hevn.

programme.title: Southern Fried Homicide: Fatal Belle
programme.desc: Som barn fikk Pat det alltid som hun ville. Nå er hun voksen, men liker fortsatt å få viljen sin. De som tør å motarbeide henne, havner raskt i jorden.

programme.title: Southern Fried Homicide: Catch Me If You Can
programme.desc: En ung kvinne blir funnet myrdet i sin leilighet. Politiet må leke katt og mus for å få en DNA-prøve fra den mistenkte morderen.

programme.title: The Dead Files: Damaged
programme.desc: Steve og Amy reiser til Winchester i Kentucky for å undersøke påstandene til en kvinne om at paranormal aktivitet har endret personligheten til ektemannen og angrepet barna hennes.

programme.title: Jack Osbourne's Night Of Terror: Glen Tavern Inn
programme.desc: Sharon Osbourne opplever en altfor ekte medisinsk nødssituasjon når hun havner i siktet til en ondsinnet ånd på et hundre år gammelt vertshus.

programme.title: Jack Osbourne's Night Of Terror: Tinker Swiss Cottage
programme.desc: Jack og hans gode venn Jenny McCarthy beroliger hvileløse sjeler i en 1800-tallshytte i Rockford i Illinois.

programme.title: Haunted Towns: Bisbee, AZ
programme.desc: Teamet drar til Bisbee i Arizona for å undersøke den gamle gruvebyens fortid. De går under jorden for første gang i sine paranormale karrierer.

programme.title: Haunted Towns: Vicksburg, MS
programme.desc: Teamet drar til Mississippi og åstedet for beleiringen av Vicksburg for å undersøke en hjemsøking som går helt tilbake til rekonstruksjonsperioden.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Concussion Quarterback
programme.desc: En fotballspiller med hjerneskade prøver å inspirere laget sitt, en mann anklager sin kone for å være utro med en hund og en restauranteier skremmer bort gjestene sine.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Alien Imposters
programme.desc: Romvesener invaderer jorden, en familie forliker seg med en slektnings homobryllup og noen rasister gir uttrykk for noen overraskende meninger.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Terrorist Meeting
programme.desc: En gangster prøver desperat å bevise at han er gal, terrorister møtes for å planlegge sitt neste trekk og en sjalu storebror gjør familiemiddagen pinlig.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Slap-Ass
programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer at kara har en dårlig Skype-forbindelse, en Django Unchained-slavekamp og en baseballspiller som klasker for mange rumper.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Black Ice News
programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer Samuel og Lashawn som gleder seg over fordelene ved sine nå lovlige ekteskap, en politibetjent som møter sin nye makker og Lando fra 'Star Wars' blir forfulgt av et superfan.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Sex Addict Wendel
programme.desc: Artister blir sparket i skrittet på grunn av kunsten sin, klassens klovn terroriserer læreren og en mann prøver å få hellet med seg på et møte for sexmisbrukere.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The 420 Special
programme.desc: Neil deGrasse Tyson slapper av hjemme, Keegan må bevare fatningen under et jobbintervju, en skredder får en klient med luft i magen, parkeringsvaktene diskuterer 'Game of Thrones' og en telefonselger prøver en ny strategi.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Airplane Showdown
programme.desc: En flyvert må håndtere en passasjer som ikke vil ha på sikkerhetsbeltet, britiske oppdagelsesreisende diskuterer sine reiser, to par forsøker å unngå spoilere på en dobbeltdate og en bibelgruppe opplever en guddommelig intervensjon.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Hollywood Sequel Doctor
programme.desc: Kileleking mellem to venner blir plutselig merkelig, forfattere brainstormer til 'Gremlins 2', to bøller mistenker vennen sin for å stjele og Keegan og Jordan diskuterer Afrika på en fest.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The End
programme.desc: Ray Parker Jr. har noen nye låter, en mann kan ikke slutte å si "deez nuts", Keegan må ringe 112 og en ung mann lærer om Negrotown.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Dubstep
programme.desc: President Obama og hans vredeoversetter, Luther, taler til Mitt Romney, vi møter mannen som skulle holde tale etter Martin Luther Kings 'I Have A Dream'-tale, og to venner prater om hva som skjer med bæsjen deres atter at de skyller ned.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Non-Stop Party
programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer en fyr som jager etter kjæresten sin til verdens ende og LMFAO som ikke kan holde opp med å feste.

programme.title: Key & Peele: MMMMMM
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan opptrer foran et oppstemt publikum, en trafikkreporter blir utsatt for turbulens i et helikopter og halvdelen av en R&B duo avslører sine sanne følelser for sin partner under en opptreden.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Das Negroes
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan prøver å gjemme seg for en negerjaktende nazist. Andre sketsjer inkluderer to slaver som sliter med å bli solgt, et par kriminelle som kommer i knipe før et stort kupp.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Aerobics Meltdown
programme.desc: Stan Lee har noen nye superhelter, og en gatesmart fyr mister sin street cred når han opplever en hjernefrysning. Og sist, men ikke minst, utvikler en mann en komplisert minnesanordning for å huske hvor han har parkert.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Flicker
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan har en flickerkamp og en MMA-fighter går for langt når han erter motstanderen. Andre sketsjer inkluderer en bryllupsgjest somvil være dj og spille "klassiske" låter.

programme.desc: I denne episoden av 'Ridiculousness' får Rob, Steelo og Lolo Wood besøk av sangeren Teddy Swims og ser nærmere på folk som 'Mister kontrollen', får faderlige råd i 'Pappavisdom og kaster ut noen problemtyper i 'Vis dem veien ut'.

programme.desc: I denne episoden av 'Ridiculousness' får Rob, Steelo og Lolo Wood problemer med å sette seg på grunn av 'Stolnasking', møter brått uventede dyr i 'Dyrestøkk' og bruker god tid på å falle i 'Gradvise fall'.

programme.desc: I denne episoden av 'Ridiculousness' får Rob, Steelo og gjestevert Lolo Wood nærbilkontakt med leppene i 'Bilkyssere', får seg et slag under beltestedet med 'Lavtslåtte damer' og orker ikke å spise når de er sammen med 'Matlystslukkere'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Lolo Wood LIX
programme.desc: I denne episoden av 'Ridiculousness' oppdager Rob, Steelo og Lolo Wood at telefoner kan være distraherende i 'Telefonblind', møter unger som bør finne seg en annen sportsgren i 'Minigolfere' og besøker noen steder der det er 'Kjempekaldt'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Lolo Wood LXII

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: What You Missed
programme.desc: Et timelangt spesialprogram midt i sesongen som oppsummerer familiefeider, svik blant bestevenner og umistelige øyeblikk fra denne sesongens New Beginnings.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Burying The Past
programme.desc: Etter nesten et år fra hverandre, gjenforenes gjengen for å begrave fortiden og starte på nytt. Brody prøver å samle kropp og sjel og fokusere på å gjøre det godt igjen etter å ha slått opp med Kaitlynn

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Best Friends Kissing
programme.desc: Brody og Audrina utforsker en ny romanse. Brandon er klar for å utvikle forholdet ytterligere. Heidi og Spencer kjemper for å bli enige om familieforøkning og må avreagere. Jason og Ashley får skjellsettende nyheter.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: The Last Hurrah
programme.desc: Gjengens ferie får en vri da Kaitlynn uventet får møte Brodys nye flamme. Brandon håp om en romantisk tur med Dani settes på spill etter en fatal karrierefeil. Samtidig blomstrer en usannsynlig forbindelse.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Who's a Better Kisser
programme.desc: Brody og Heidis vennskap er i et skjæringspunkt da en middag utvikler seg til en eksplosiv krangel. Brody lurer på om Amber er den rette. Audrinas første kyss med Sean gir flere spørsmål. Justin åpner seg for gruppen.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: You Told Her?!
programme.desc: Heidi og Spencer blir sjokkerte over at oppførselen deres blir diskutert. Audrina står ved en korsvei med både Brody og Sean; samtidig foretar Caroline en djerv påstand om sine ekte følelser for Kaitlynn.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: I'm Back in LA Bitches!
programme.desc: Gjengen feirer Kristin Cavallaris besøk i LA. Det er anspent mellom Heidi og Audrina. Justin og Jason styrker vennskapet. En bra natt blir til en god morgen da Brody og Audrina endelig setter følelsene sine på prøve.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: "Who Slept at Your House?"
programme.desc: Da Kristin har grillet Brody om 'overnattingen' hos Audrina, går ryktene under en tur til Lake Tahoe, og Kaitlynn føler seg utenfor. Caroline konfronterer Kaitlynn om det kalde vennskapet. Jason hører Spencer tvile på edrueligheten sin.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Get Dessert and Bail
programme.desc: Brody og Audrinas flørting blir hetere. Krigen mellom Pratt- og Wahler-familiene koker over, mens Brandon blir fryst ut av Danis kalde skulder etter at de flyttet sammen. Audrina og Heidis vennskap er ved et veiskille.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Time Heals Not Some Things
programme.desc: Heidi og Spencer søker hjelp for sin finansielle situasjon. Mens Kaitlynns nye forhold fortsetter å blomstre, truer en av Brandons gamle flørter å ødelegge ting mellom ham og Dani. Justin og faren blir kjent igjen etter en vanskelig tid.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: That's Math Right There
programme.desc: Kaitlynns avgjørelse om å flytte inn med kjæresten får alle til å lure på hva som skjer. Heidi & Spencer bekymrer seg for selskapet. Brandon revurderer forholdet sitt, mens Audrina får en vekker angående Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: What About Me?
programme.desc: På Speidis velværeanstalt går det rykter om at Kaitlynn er gravid. Brandon avslører sjokkerenede nyheter om forholdet. Familien Wahlers kamp for å slutte fred med familien Pratt, blir distrahert av mulige skjellsettende forandringer for egen del.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Timing Is Everything
programme.desc: Kaitlynn knekker nyheten om sin graviditet til Brody, men er urolig når han og Kris skal møtes på fristedet. Pratt- og Wahler-gjengen håndterer endelig feiden som har delt gruppen. Justin får lære viktigheten av å vedlikeholde kontakter.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 515
programme.desc: Luma tar med seg hele familien for å kjøpe nye klær til barna, og Natalie lærer Alicia å sykle uten støttehjul. Fayme drar på piknik med barna.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 516
programme.desc: Ellinor forteller om sine problemer med amming. Luma tar med seg hele familien ut i skogen for å plukke sopp.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 517
programme.desc: Luma tar med barna til lekeland, og Natalie lærer barna hvordan man potter om planter og sår frø. Ellinor vil lage en gipsavstøpning av Aarons hender og føtter.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 518
programme.desc: Sonia treffer sin søster som ikke er spesielt fan av hennes planer om å bli politimann. Natalie føler seg uvel og blir bortskjemt av sine døtre.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 519
programme.desc: Ellinor og Jimmy tar med Aaron ned til vannet for å fiske, og Niffi og barna drar for å treffe mormor og tante i parken. Fayme skal ta en ny tatovering.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 520
programme.desc: Ellinor tar med Aaron på hans første modelljobb for å ta bilder til bloggen og Instagram-kontoen hennes. Natalie vil lære barna å ri på hesten Bubben.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 601
programme.desc: I første episode blir vi kjent med den nye sprudlende mammaen Izabell Soldati, og får et kjært gjensyn med de frittalende trebarnsmødrene Fayme Elmén og Luma Alalawi.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 602
programme.desc: Ellinor Bjurström forteller om hvordan det gikk når hun skulle slutte å amme sønnen Aaron, Sonia Kamikazi lengter etter å begynne å jobbe igjen, og slekten kommer på besøk til Natalie Eklind.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 603
programme.desc: Izabell forteller for første gang om fødselen og de skjebnesvangre minuttene. Luma forklarer hvorfor hun velger å ha slør, og Fayme synes det er vanskelig å slutte med ammingen av datteren Mila.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 604
programme.desc: Ellinor og Jimmy ansetter en ekspert på barnesikkerhet for å se hvilke farer som finnes i deres nybygde hjem. Sonia prøver å få Daisy til å slutte å bruke smokk. Natalie røper hva hennes nye drøm er.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 605
programme.desc: Faymes sønn Colin har en selektiv spiseforstyrrelse og Fayme prøver å komme på nye matforslag sammen med ham. Luma forteller om da hun møtte mannen sin som 16-åring. Izabell tar en graviditetstest.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 606
programme.desc: Natalie, Richard og barna leker i parken, og Natalie røper at Richard skal adoptere hennes tre barn. Ellinor og Jimmy tar med Aaron på sin første utenlandsreise. Sonia og barna drar til IKEA.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 607
programme.desc: Luma skal ta familiebilder i parken og synes synd på fotografen. Izabell lager sin egen mat til Domeniq. Fayme rydder sammen med barna og lærer dem å rydde etter seg.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 608
programme.desc: Natalie prøver å få Cornelia til å slutte å amme. Ellinor forteller om forholdet til Jimmy, og han forbereder en overraskelse til henne. Sonia tar barna med til parken for å leke.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 609
programme.desc: Izabell forteller at hun traff forloveden fordi han var storebroren til hennes beste venn. Fayme drar og bader med Leo. Luma og barna fikser og ordner i hagen.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 610
programme.desc: Ellinor tar med sønnen Aaron på et event og forteller om hvordan hun har kjempet for å leve det livet hun gjør i dag. Sonia lærer Daisy å sykle og Natalie innreder lekehuset sammen med barna.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 611
programme.desc: Izabell er gravid og lar sønnen Domeniq avsløre graviditeten for ektemannen. Fayme tar med barna i second hand-butikker, og Luma og barna drar for å spille tennis.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 612
programme.desc: Sonia forteller om da hun ble gravid og om skadene hun pådro seg under den første fødselen. Natalie lærer Richard å ri på hesten sin, og Ellinor og Jimmy prøver å få hverdagen til å fungere.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 613
programme.desc: Luma reiser med familien til Istanbul for å operere nesen. Izabell forteller om bestefaren som tilbrakte 30 år i finsk fengsel. Fayme og Moltas feirer deres bryllupsdag og drar bort uten barna.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 614
programme.desc: Ellinor har hatt astma hele livet, men trosser det for å teste en ny form for trening. Sonia går på tre-års kontroll, har fest for Lily og reflekterer over hvor fantastisk det er å gi liv.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 615
programme.desc: Luma våkner opp etter neseoperasjonen og blir forelsket i sin nye nese, spørsmålet er hva familien kommer til å si? Fayme sjonglerer tre jobber, men har sagt opp en av dem for å leve som influencer.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 616
